 I'll get a preview posted for the Japanese data soon (ADDED, here it is: Japan services PPI preview: 3.7% pace in focus ahead of Friday’s BoJ decision ). In brief, while the services PPI is rarely a big mover for the yen on its own, but a reading at or above 3.7% would reinforce December hike pricing and lend modest support to the yen and short-dated JGB yields into Friday.
